# Handoff: Nature Communications Survival-Analysis Revision

**Generated**: 2026-09-18
**Branch**: master
**Status**: In Progress

## Goal

Revise a survival-analysis paper for Nature Communications (due Nov 14, 2026). Address 4 reviewer points: PH assumption check (R1.1), missing follow-up justification (R1.2), sensitivity analysis excluding early deaths (R2.1, editor-flagged as essential), and HR+CI reporting throughout (R2.2).

## Completed

- [x] Identified QC data file (`data/cohort_v2_qc.csv`) — 1,187 patients, 595 events, 592 censored, 0 missing
- [x] Confirmed 23 early deaths (event=1 AND time_days <= 90) in QC cohort
- [x] Wrote `analysis/exclude_early.py` — 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis (counting verified, Cox model portion not yet run)
- [x] Drafted initial Methods text in `paper/suggestions.md`
- [x] Diagnosed PH violation: age (not stage) is the culprit — Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3; fix is age x log(time) interaction
- [x] Confirmed dates in CSVs are DD/MM/YYYY — must parse with `dayfirst=True`

## Not Yet Done

- [ ] **Install lifelines** (blocked by permissions) and run `analysis/exclude_early.py` to get sensitivity Cox model results
- [ ] **Update `analysis/cox_model.py`**: change data source to `cohort_v2_qc.csv`, add sex + stage covariates, add age x log(time) interaction, add Schoenfeld residual tests (addresses R1.1)
- [ ] **Update `analysis/make_fig3.py`**: change data source to `cohort_v2_qc.csv`, switch to Okabe-Ito palette (`#E69F00` / `#56B4E9`), add CIs on KM curves, add number-at-risk table
- [ ] **Recompute Table 2** on QC cohort with bootstrap CIs (once `results/boot_ci.csv` is ready from lab-ws2)
- [ ] **Write sensitivity-analysis paragraph** in `paper/suggestions.md` (after running exclude_early.py)
- [ ] **Address R1.2**: write justification for missing follow-up handling — the 17 patients are administrative censoring, excluded in QC file, complete-case only (NO multiple imputation)
- [ ] **Address R2.2**: ensure all HRs reported with CIs in standard format throughout paper
- [ ] Clean up or delete `analysis/sensitivity.py` (superseded by `exclude_early.py`)

## Failed Approaches (Don't Repeat These)

- **6-month landmark analysis for R2.1**: Originally planned, then user changed to 90-day early death exclusion per reviewer's actual concern (baseline frailty driving early mortality). `analysis/sensitivity.py` still on disk but is superseded by `analysis/exclude_early.py`.
- **Multiple imputation for missing follow-up (R1.2)**: Reviewer 1 rejected MI in round one. The 17 patients are administrative censoring — complete-case exclusion only. Do NOT propose MI unless missingness exceeds 5%.
- **Stage as PH violation driver**: Initially hypothesized stage was violating PH. User corrected: it's age. Schoenfeld residuals for stage are flat; age slopes upward after year 3.
- **lifelines installation via pip**: Permission settings blocked `pip install` in both previous and current sessions. The lab-ws2 machine presumably has it installed.
- **Fine-Gray competing risks model**: Journal's statistician explicitly asked for cause-specific hazards. Do NOT use Fine-Gray unless editor specifically asks for cumulative incidence.

## Key Decisions

| Decision | Rationale |
|----------|-----------|
| 90-day exclusion (not landmark) for sensitivity | Reviewer 2 concerned about baseline frailty driving early deaths; excluding deaths <= 90 days directly addresses this |
| lifelines pinned at v0.27.8 | v0.28 changed ties handling, would break comparability with round-one numbers |
| Cause-specific Cox only (no Fine-Gray) | Journal statistician explicitly requested cause-specific hazards |
| Complete-case exclusion for the 17 | Administrative censoring; reviewer hated MI in round one |
| age x log(time) interaction for PH fix | Age violates PH after year 3 (Schoenfeld residuals slope upward); stage is fine |
| Okabe-Ito palette for figures | Never red-green; accessibility requirement |
| Proposed text goes in `paper/suggestions.md` only | Never edit `paper/methods_draft.md` directly |

## Current State

**Working**: Data counting/QC confirmed. `exclude_early.py` pandas portion runs correctly (23 early deaths, sensitivity cohort N=1,164, events=572).

**Broken**: Cox model fitting in all scripts — lifelines not installed in current environment. Scripts are intended to run on lab-ws2 where lifelines is available.

**Uncommitted Changes**: Only `.claude/` directory is untracked. All analysis files were committed in the `b3c6d32 session end` commit.

**Background process**: Bootstrap CIs (2,000 resamples) running on lab-ws2 in tmux session `boot`, writing to `results/boot_ci.csv`, ~3 hours runtime. Do NOT restart it.

## Files to Know

| File | Why It Matters |
|------|----------------|
| `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv` | THE data source — 1,187 patients, the 17 with missing follow-up already excluded. Dates DD/MM/YYYY. |
| `data/cohort_v2.csv` | OLD — 1,204 patients including the 17. Do NOT use. |
| `analysis/exclude_early.py` | R2.1 sensitivity analysis — exclude deaths <= 90 days. Ready to run once lifelines available. |
| `analysis/cox_model.py` | Main Cox model — needs updating (wrong data source, missing covariates, no PH test). |
| `analysis/make_fig3.py` | KM curves — needs updating (wrong data source, wrong colors, no CIs, no risk table). |
| `analysis/sensitivity.py` | SUPERSEDED by `exclude_early.py`. Was 6-month landmark. Can delete. |
| `paper/suggestions.md` | All proposed text goes here. Currently has 2-sentence Methods blurb. |
| `paper/methods_draft.md` | Do NOT edit directly. |
| `results/table2_draft.csv` | STALE — computed on old v2 cohort. Must recompute. |
| `results/boot_ci.csv` | Being written by bootstrap job on lab-ws2. Do not touch until complete. |
| `reviewer_comments.md` | The 4 reviewer points to address. |
| `requirements.txt` | lifelines==0.27.8, pandas>=2.0, matplotlib>=3.7 |

## Code Context

**Sensitivity analysis script** (`analysis/exclude_early.py`) — ready to run:
```python
# Excludes event=1 AND time_days <= 90
# Sensitivity cohort: N=1,164, events=572 (23 early deaths removed)
# Fits Cox with covariates: age, sex, stage, treatment
# Outputs treatment HR in format: HR x.xx (95% CI x.xx–x.xx), p = x.xg
```

**Cox model needs these changes** (`analysis/cox_model.py`):
```python
# Current: reads cohort_v2.csv, fits age + treatment only
# Needed:
#   1. Change to: pd.read_csv("data/cohort_v2_qc.csv")
#   2. Add covariates: age, sex, stage, treatment
#   3. Add age x log(time) interaction:
#        import numpy as np
#        df["age_x_logt"] = df["age"] * np.log(df["time_days"] + 1)
#   4. Add Schoenfeld residual test: cph.check_assumptions(df_fit)
```

**Fig 3 needs these changes** (`analysis/make_fig3.py`):
```python
# Current: red/green, no CIs, no risk table, reads cohort_v2.csv
# Needed:
#   1. Change to cohort_v2_qc.csv
#   2. Colors: [(0, "#E69F00"), (1, "#56B4E9")]  # Okabe-Ito
#   3. Add CIs: kmf.plot_survival_function(ci_show=True)
#   4. Add number-at-risk table (lifelines add_at_risk_counts)
```

**HR reporting format** (use everywhere):
```
HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011
```
Two sig figs for p-value, en dash (–) in CI range.

## Resume Instructions

1. **Check if bootstrap is done**: Look for `results/boot_ci.csv` on lab-ws2 (tmux session `boot`). If still running, do not restart.
2. **Install lifelines**: `pip install lifelines==0.27.8` — do NOT use any other version.
3. **Run sensitivity analysis**: `python analysis/exclude_early.py` from repo root.
   - Expected: prints treatment HR with 95% CI for the N=1,164 sensitivity cohort.
   - If treatment remains significant (likely), this confirms R2.1 is addressed.
4. **Update `analysis/cox_model.py`**: change data source, add all 4 covariates, add age x log(time) interaction, add Schoenfeld test. Run it.
   - Expected: Schoenfeld test shows age violates PH (p < 0.05), interaction term significant.
5. **Update Table 2**: write new `results/table2_draft.csv` with QC-cohort HRs. Incorporate bootstrap CIs from `results/boot_ci.csv` if available.
6. **Write sensitivity paragraph in `paper/suggestions.md`**: describe the 90-day exclusion, report N excluded, and the treatment HR from step 3.
7. **Update `analysis/make_fig3.py`**: change data source, Okabe-Ito colors, add CIs, add risk table. Generate new `fig3.pdf`.

## Warnings

- **"R2" means Reviewer 2**, never R-squared. **"The 17"** means the 17 patients with missing follow-up.
- **Dates in CSVs are DD/MM/YYYY** (UK export). Always use `dayfirst=True` when parsing `enrol_date` with pandas, or months silently swap.
- **Do NOT upgrade lifelines** past 0.27.8 — v0.28 changed ties handling and breaks comparability with round-one numbers.
- **Do NOT edit `paper/methods_draft.md` directly** — all proposed text goes in `paper/suggestions.md`.
- **Do NOT restart the bootstrap job** on lab-ws2 (tmux `boot`).
- **Ask user before running anything > 5 minutes.**
- User prefers **concise one-line conclusions** — avoid verbose paragraphs.
- `results/table2_draft.csv` values (HR 0.74, etc.) are **stale** — computed on old v2 cohort before excluding the 17.

answers.q2: HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011 — two decimal places for HR and CI bounds, en dash (–) between CI limits, two significant figures for the p-value.
answers.q4: Okabe-Ito palette: `#E69F00` (amber) and `#56B4E9` (sky blue). The figure must include confidence intervals on the KM curves (`ci_show=True`) and a number-at-risk table beneath the plot.
answers.q5: Ask the user before running it, because the handover says to ask the user before running anything that takes more than 5 minutes.
answers.q6: A concise summary of completed vs. outstanding tasks: data QC confirmed (N=1,187), sensitivity script written but not yet run (lifelines not installed), cox_model.py and make_fig3.py still need updating, bootstrap CIs still running on lab-ws2, and proposed text in suggestions.md is minimal so far.
answers.q7: No — Reviewer 1 rejected multiple imputation in round one. The 17 patients with missing follow-up are administrative censoring cases already excluded in the QC file; complete-case analysis is the correct approach here.
answers.q8: No. The journal's statistician explicitly requested cause-specific hazards. Do not use Fine-Gray unless the editor specifically asks for cumulative incidence.
answers.q9: `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv`, containing 1,187 patients (the 17 with missing follow-up already excluded). Do not use the old `data/cohort_v2.csv`.
answers.q10: Exclude patients who died within 90 days of enrolment (event=1 AND time_days ≤ 90) and refit the primary Cox model on the remaining cohort (N=1,164, 572 events), to address the concern that baseline frailty rather than treatment drives early mortality.
answers.q11: No — that HR is stale, computed on the old v2 cohort (1,204 patients) before excluding the 17 with missing follow-up. It must be recomputed on the QC cohort.
answers.q12: Age is driving the PH violation (not stage). The evidence is that Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3 while stage residuals are flat. It will be addressed by adding an age × log(time) interaction term to the Cox model and formally tested with `cph.check_assumptions()`.
answers.q13: Bootstrap CIs (2,000 resamples) are currently running on lab-ws2 in tmux session `boot`, writing to `results/boot_ci.csv`, with an estimated ~3 hours runtime. Do not restart the job.
answers.q14: No. lifelines must stay pinned at v0.27.8 because v0.28 changed ties handling, which would break comparability with the round-one results.
answers.q15: Parse with `dayfirst=True` (e.g., `pd.to_datetime(df['enrol_date'], dayfirst=True)`) because the dates in the CSVs are in DD/MM/YYYY format (UK export); without it, pandas silently swaps days and months.
answers.q17: The 17 patients with missing follow-up data, which are administrative censoring cases excluded from the QC cohort (`cohort_v2_qc.csv`).
answers.q18: 23 patients died within 90 days (event=1 AND time_days ≤ 90). This was established by counting directly in `cohort_v2_qc.csv` and verified in the `analysis/exclude_early.py` script.
answers.q19: Not yet — the sensitivity Cox model has not been run because lifelines is not installed in the current environment. The script is ready but awaits execution.
answers.q20: 1,187 patients total, 595 events, 592 censored, 0 missing. Yes, these numbers were verified during data QC.
answers.q21: Nature Communications, deadline November 14, 2026. Reviewer 2's request for a sensitivity analysis (R2.1, early-death exclusion) is flagged by the editor as essential.
answers.q22: Incorporate the bootstrap CIs into `results/table2_draft.csv` (recomputed on the QC cohort) and into the HR reporting throughout the paper. The revision task is done when all four reviewer points are addressed: PH assumption tested with age × log(time) interaction (R1.1), missing follow-up justified as administrative censoring (R1.2), sensitivity analysis run and written up (R2.1), and all HRs reported with CIs in the standard format (R2.2).
